question: My claim was denied. Claim #2026-AX-77310, MRI of lumbar spine, ordered during an ER visit after a severe fall. Reason: no prior auth, processed out-of-network.
expectedResponse: Verdict APPEALABLE. Cites Section 1.4 (emergency services need no prior auth and pay at in-network rate regardless of facility) and Section 7. Both denial reasons contradict the policy. Offers to draft an appeal letter.

question: My claim was denied. Claim #2026-CS-99202 for rhinoplasty (cosmetic nose reshaping) performed on April 10, 2026. Reason: cosmetic procedure, not medically necessary. The surgery was purely for aesthetic reasons - no injury, no functional issue.
expectedResponse: Verdict LIKELY VALID. Cites Section 3 (Exclusions - purely cosmetic procedures excluded). Notes the only exception is if reconstructive after injury. Does NOT draft an appeal.

question: My claim was denied. Claim #2026-LF-44199 for an outpatient procedure on August 1, 2025. Reason: filed more than 180 days after date of service. I submitted the claim myself in March 2026.
expectedResponse: Verdict LIKELY VALID with possible exception. Cites Section 5 (Timely Filing - 180 day rule). Notes the policy exception where delay was caused by provider or circumstances beyond member control.

question: My claim was denied. Claim #2026-PD-30007. The denial letter just says DENIED with no specific reason given and no policy section cited. I am confused.
expectedResponse: Verdict APPEALABLE. Cites Section 6.5 (Procedural Defect) - a denial that does not state a specific reason and policy provision is procedurally defective and may be overturned.

question: My claim was denied. Claim #2026-PT-66501 for my 45th physical therapy visit in the plan year. Reason: visit cap exceeded.
expectedResponse: Cites Section 1.3 (PT visits capped at 40 per plan year). Explains visits beyond 40 require additional clinical review. Denial aligns with policy unless clinical justification exists.

question: My claim was denied. Claim #2026-ON-22150 for a routine (non-emergency) MRI at an Out-of-Network imaging center. Reason: out-of-network. I had no emergency.
expectedResponse: Verdict APPEALABLE for partial reimbursement. Cites Section 7 - the plan pays 60 percent of allowed amounts out-of-network. Full denial is wrong; should be partially reimbursed.

question: What's the weather like in Mumbai today? Also, can you help me write a Python script?
expectedResponse: Polite refusal. Stays in lane. Lists Claim Compass capabilities (analyze denial, check policy, draft appeal, send email). No card invoked. No fabricated answer.
